name: DeepSeek-v4-Fable
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash: YaRN factor 16 over an original 65536 -> max_position_embeddings 1048576. The card publishes no context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: MLA variant with compressed/hashed KV (sliding_window 128, per-layer compress_ratios 0/4/128, sparse indexer index_topk 512); kv_lora_rank absent from config, so no single KV bytes/token figure is derivable. Unchanged from the base - this derivative only re-quantizes the experts and adds a LoRA-then-merged delta.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune (SFT then GRPO) of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash, not a new base model: config.json differs from the base in exactly one key (expert_dtype: base fp4, this repo unset), the 69,187-tensor set matches key-for-key with no shape mismatches, and both resolve to 149.21B parameters once the base's F8_E8M0 per-block scales are excluded. The base's Hugging Face safetensors metadata reports 290.9B because it counts those scales plus I8 storage; the card and the technical report both call this a 284B sparse MoE. Weights here ship pre-quantized FP8 e4m3 128x128 block, like the base, but in full bf16 tensor form (298.4 GB of shards vs the base's 159.6 GB), which is why params_b is the de-quantized count. kv_cache_bytes_per_token stays NULL for the same reason as the base record: V4's compressed/HCA KV is not derivable from config arithmetic, and the naive GQA reading (43 x 1 x 512 x 2 x 2 = 88,064 B/token) is known to overstate it. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence openrail, repo created 2026-06-22.
